parent/related issue: #1383

Current 10.1.1

_Lead developers should regularly review code check-ins, particularly those that might access time, I/O, or network functions._

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **10.1.1** | Verify that a code analysis tool is in use that can detect potentially malicious code, such as time functions, unsafe file operations and network connections. | | | ✓ | 749 |

By the requirement text and introduction before it, it seems to be more development process requirement and is out of scope.

My question is - what this code analysis tool need to provide? What is the difference if the tool is used and when it's not used.

parent/related issue: #1383

Current 10.1.1

_Lead developers should regularly review code check-ins, particularly those that might access time, I/O, or network functions._

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **10.1.1** | Verify that a code analysis tool is in use that can detect potentially malicious code, such as time functions, unsafe file operations and network connections. | | | ✓ | 749 |

By the requirement text and introduction before it, it seems to be more development process requirement and is out of scope.

My question is - what this code analysis tool need to provide? What is the difference if the tool is used and when it's not used.

[CWE-749](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/749.html): Exposed Dangerous Method or Function - it can be used when we target the application code, not the review process.

edit: added 1.10.1.

I think 1.10.1 is pretty much the same - it's more development process than application.

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **1.10.1** | Verify that a source code control system is in use, with procedures to ensure that check-ins are accompanied by issues or change tickets. The source code control system should have access control and identifiable users to allow traceability of any changes. | | ✓ | ✓ | 284 |

[CWE-284](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/284.html): Improper Access Control - this should be used when the problem is in the application or the testing scope is development process (but then it's not anymore _Application_ Security Verification Standard)
